does: it adds the hook h2: POST /hooks/h2 takes deliveries from the source linear (https://api.linear.app).

what it sends in: deliveries are verified by HMAC-SHA256 over the body (scheme hmac-sha256, signed: body), the signature in the header Linear-Signature as hex past the prefix none; a delivery is named by the header Linear-Delivery; its time arrives at webhookTimestamp, in ms within 1m of the yard's clock; bodies are unique; the command [/bin/false] turns a verified body into the envelope, handed no credential; its events may carry the fields team, project, label.
the signing secret is given on the hook's own secret card for h2 and kept in /synthetic/yard/hooks/h2.secret (mode 0600); the hook names that file, and the value is in no note, event or answer.

weight.line: widens who the yard listens to: POST /hooks/h2 takes deliveries from outside the yard for the source linear
